label: Wait with no exit
description: A state that nothing moves out of: no deadline, no owner, no sweeper.

label: Two copies
description: Two processes or two lists keep one state, and the copies can disagree.

label: Illegal move
description: The store or type accepts a move between states that the rules forbid.

label: Illegal combination
description: Fields that together describe one state can hold values that contradict each other.

label: Free-string state
description: A state is a string literal with no enum, CHECK, or single list behind it.

label: Prose guard
description: A rule lives in a comment or a doc and no code enforces it.

label: Replay gap
description: A retry, replay, or restart repeats work, loses it, or answers differently.

label: Lost work
description: A path can drop data or work without telling anyone.

label: Race
description: The result depends on which of two concurrent calls arrives first.

label: Chat
description: Operator says from Pulse or terminal, the Host chat ring, and the OMP chat doorman that answers them.

title: A throw after the claim leaves the chat doorman stuck
text: The doorman sets pendingSayId before sendMessage. If sendMessage throws, the catch only warns. Only the Host ack clears pendingSayId, so each later tick returns early and room chat stops until stopChatDoorman.

title: A say turn that never settles has no exit
text: noteChatTurnEnd settles only when chatOutcome returns an answer. No timer moves Injected to Settled, so the say can stay in flight with no deadline.

title: A restart injects the same say into OMP again
text: Doorman state is in memory only. After a restart chatNext returns the same unanswered say and OMP answers it again. The ring keeps one spirit line; the cost is a second OMP turn.

title: GUI message flags permit contradictory combinations
text: pending, accepted and unconfirmed are independent booleans. pending with accepted, and accepted with unconfirmed, are representable. The writers keep them consistent today.

title: Doorman fields permit contradictory combinations
text: settledReport with a null draft, and a draft with a null pendingSayId, are representable. The writers keep them consistent today.

title: Expired pending knock stays pending forever
text: The sweep moves only claimed and started rows. The claim query skips expired rows. No writer fails a pending row. The unique key then refuses a new knock on the same message.

title: Expiry runs only inside the recipient's claim
text: The sweep is in claim only. The doorman does not claim while it holds an active knock. A room with KnockAutonomy off never claims. An expired claimed or started row stays non-terminal.

title: Settle ignores expires_at
text: Settle checks the lease and the status only. A started row past expires_at becomes completed when settle arrives first. The same row becomes failed when a claim sweep arrives first.

title: Started turn that never ends has no adapter exit
text: KnockPlan fails a knock only on three timers. No rule covers turnStarted with no turnEnded. The doorman stays active and the room claims no new knock.

title: A crash loses the active knock
text: The doorman state lives only in memory. A claimed row becomes reclaimable after 30 s and the next claim injects it again. A started row has no reclaim path and fails at expires_at.

title: Turn end is not bound to the knock id
text: noteHallwayKnockTurnEnd runs on every agent_end and checks only state.active. A busy turn that ends before interruptSent is set is treated as the knock turn, and the plan settles completed.

title: SQL started records delivery, not turn start
text: KnockPlan returns started when delivered is true and turnStarted is false. started_at holds the delivery time. The 60-second did-not-start failure fires on a row that SQL already calls started.

title: Adapter fields permit contradictory combinations
text: startSettled with delivered false, and turnEnded with active null, are representable. clearActiveKnock keeps the phase latches consistent. It does not reset settling.

title: Knock status vocabulary has no single type
text: HallwayKnockOutcome names three statuses. The pointer uses a free string. A doc comment says omitted roots use four turns. The default is 10.

label: Restart
description: Self-restart of one OMP session: SQL intents, Host journal, adapter door, and keeper relaunch.

title: HandedToKeeper record has no exit
text: The Host never verifies a keeper successor. No Host code reads the SQL outcome for this record. The journal keeps the stage HandedToKeeper.

title: Expired restart command leaves record at Requested
text: The command deadline is the intent TTL. Expire and retire change commands only. No writer moves the record out of Requested. Attach counts Requested as live, so the instance cannot switch conversation until the Host restarts.

title: finish_failed can overwrite Verified
text: The relaunch loop releases the lock before the deadline test. An attach can verify in that window. finish_failed then writes Failed with no from-stage guard. The Host says Failed and SQL says verified.

title: Verified record can stay unsaved in the journal
text: verify_successor changes the record with no journal write. The next save comes only after a later mutating request. A Host restart before that save loads relaunching as Failed while SQL says verified.

title: Host Failed with no claim token leaves intent live
text: The Host writes Failed before it calls fail. When the claim is refused, fail returns with a warning only. The intent holds the workspace until a later restart_request sweeps it.

title: failed_stage names a stage the restart never reached
text: fail claims the intent only to fail it. A restart refused at requested lands on failed:claimed. A Tern exit past its deadline also lands on failed:claimed. The CHECK allows failed_stage requested and no writer sets it.

title: SQL types permit contradictory combinations
text: The claim CHECK ignores state. Deadline columns are not tied to a state. A proof row can name another claim_epoch. Writers keep these consistent today; deadline columns stay set after claimed and verified.

title: Restart state list exists in three copies
text: RestartState::from_str and the SQL CHECK hold the state list. The Host journal reads unknown stage text as Failed and unknown command text as OutcomeUnknown, with no error.

title: Host restart records are never pruned
text: The only removal is on a failed journal write. The journal grows by one row for each restart.

title: SQL does not refuse an illegal state move
text: No trigger guards state. The CHECKs test shape only. The Rust doors hold the legal moves.

title: Submitted quest with one rejected item has no exit
text: A quest settles only when all items are met or not_applicable. Any other verdict leaves the quest submitted. A second verdict on the same item is refused. No writer moves the quest to refused, blocked, or offered.

title: Expired lease has no active exit
text: After lease expiry the attempt stays active and the quest stays claimed. Only a new claim moves it, through lazy reclaim. No sweeper exists. The clock still lists the quest as claimed.

title: Eleven declared states have no writer
text: Quest refused, blocked, quarantined, cancelled; attempt finished, failed, abandoned; goal offered, blocked, retired, cancelled have no writer. The goal guard offered arm cannot match. The 0025 draft-to-cancelled door and cancel_requested are unused.

title: Re-armed quest starts with an empty ledger
text: Re-arm inserts the new quest directly as offered. The rearmed event goes to the old quest id. The new quest has no drafted or activated event row.

title: Replayed quest draft creates a twin row
text: docket.quests has no idempotency column. Each draft call inserts a new row. The event key is unique per quest, so the replay key does not conflict. FEATURES.md says a replayed draft returns the existing row; that is true only for goals.

title: SQL accepts any move and contradictory rows
text: No trigger guards a move. settled to offered and yielded to active are legal. claim_epoch can decrease. settled_at is not tied to settled. A pending item can carry settled_by fields. Two active attempts on one quest are representable.

title: Re-arm ignores the goal status
text: The re-arm query joins goals and tests only recurrence_interval IS NOT NULL. A draft goal can re-arm a quest. A retired or cancelled goal can too, when a writer for those states exists.

title: Replay results differ by action
text: A replayed claim returns the first result. A replayed submit fails with stale_lease. A replayed settle fails with already settled. A replayed activate fails with not activatable.

title: Rust state lists can drift from SQL CHECKs
text: QUEST_STATES and ITEM_VERDICTS copy the SQL lists by hand. Goal status and attempt state have no Rust list. Writers use inline SQL literals.

title: SQL permits illegal queue moves and lease shapes
text: No trigger guards a move on giga_events.queue_state. A running row with no lease and a succeeded row with no processed_at are representable. Migration 0004 sets failed with no queue_state filter and leaves locked_at set.

title: Purge deletes claimable pending work and retires its turn
text: The purge deletes every pending event with no waiting_since and no candidate. The foreign key then retires the turn identity. A later capture counts as a duplicate and writes no event. The turn is never classified.

title: Two writers own review_state; promote skips can_transition
text: giga_review writes review_state with a compare-and-set. giga_promote writes a hard-coded in_review to promoted move. It does not call can_transition and does not check rows_affected.

title: Four review states have no writer path in
text: giga_review refuses promoted, merged, corrected and superseded. giga_promote writes only promoted. can_transition permits all three. No writer reads expires_at. No writer sets successor_candidate_id.

title: Review ledger is mutable and SQL does not bind its pairs
text: giga_reviews has no append-only trigger. The CHECKs accept any pair of states and any action with any new_state. An outside write can make review_state disagree with the ledger.

title: Second ingest door bypasses turn identities
text: giga_event_ingest accepts a conversation_window event and writes no turn identity row. If that event id equals a canonical turn id, a later capture refuses the batch. A current caller of this path is not verified.

title: Rust types do not cover the stored state values
text: lease_expired has no GigaEventFinishOutcome value. GigaQueueState has no transition table and akasha writes queue states as string literals. The turn identity state has no Rust type.

title: A conflict turn identity has no exit
text: Only migration 0043 writes conflict = TRUE. No Rust writer changes a conflict row. A capture of a conflict turn always fails. The replay refusal tells the operator to repair the evidence, and no tool does this repair.

title: Memory supersede repoints a superseded row and permits a cycle
text: The memory supersede UPDATE has no superseded_by IS NULL predicate. An already superseded row gets a new successor. A rewrite of A with supersedes=[B] after B supersedes A makes A->B and B->A. Only the self-skip exists.

title: Memory rewrite keeps the superseded or archived state
text: The upsert SET list omits superseded_by and archived_at. A rewrite of a superseded memory changes its body, and recall still hides the row. The writer gets no warning, so the operator correction is lost.

title: Memory Archived and canon archived have no production writer
text: Only test code sets memory archived_at, and it sets superseded_by on the same row. Only test code sets canon archived. The canon CHECK accepts archived with any superseded_by value.

title: Design-document delete makes its predecessor current again
text: The design FK uses ON DELETE SET NULL, so a successor delete makes the predecessor Current. The unique index refuses the delete when another current row has the same identity. The memory FK refuses the same delete. The three tables use different delete policies.

title: Canon schema accepts two active names that differ only in case
text: The active unique index compares name exactly. Only canon_write compares lower(name). A direct SQL write can create Kodo and kodo as two active entities in one room.

title: Ledger write can reopen a closed presence row
text: persist_presence calls presence_session_open when the ledger write refuses. Compile and settle use this path. In one process the close removes the in-memory session first. A second process with a live session can reopen the row.

title: Install crash leaves pointers ahead of the database
text: The install writes the native pointer, then the component pointer, then migrates the database. The undo plan is in memory only. A stop after the first write leaves the new version active with no recovery. Host self-migration is unverified.

title: Rollback crash leaves old pointer over newer schema
text: Rollback activates the older release before it restores its database. If the process stops between these steps, the service stays stopped. The next start runs the older release against the newer schema.

title: A second rollback rolls forward and loses data
text: Rollback sets previous_version to the current version and stores a backup taken under the newer schema. A second rollback activates the newer release and restores that backup. Data written between the two commands is lost.

title: Failed-install restore bypasses validated pointer writers
text: The failed-install restore writes captured raw bytes of both pointers. It skips the write_current check and ComponentPointer::validate. Today the bytes come from files the same process checked, so it is a second owner of pointer bytes.

title: Lineage rule has five copies; two readers skip it
text: Five places copy the lineage check. The native runtime and the service start parse CurrentRelease and join version into a path with no safe_version check. The writer validates, so no current writer makes a bad value.

title: Failed pointer restore aborts rollback recovery
text: Each rollback failure path calls restore_activation_pointers with the ? operator. If that call fails, the function returns at once. The undo database restore and the service start do not run, so the service stays stopped.

title: CurrentRelease type permits contradictory field pairs
text: The type permits previous_version without rollback_backup, and rollback_backup without previous_version. Writers keep the first case out. A first install with an external database writes the second case, which no reader uses.

label: Worker lifecycle
description: Swarm, book, and instance lifecycle: engine, AKASHA and Vault stores, OMP adapter.

label: Host
description: The room Host process: HTTP and WebSocket surface, organ bridge, portable sessions, chat ring, presence.

label: Install
description: Native installer, release pointers, services, and the desktop launcher.

label: OMP keeper
description: Sidecar that resolves the installed release and relaunches OMP sessions.

label: Protocol
description: Shared wire types between Host, adapter, and AKASHA: organ operations, restart, chat.

label: OMP adapter
description: The OMP extension: doormen, tools, lesson triggers, session and restart doors.

label: Pulse
description: The operator surface: the web prototype and the desktop proxy that serves it.

label: Substrate
description: PostgreSQL migrations and the local deploy and provisioning scripts.

label: Interactive process
description: Starts and supervises child processes with a console on Windows.

title: Stores do not enforce forward-only instance state
text: The AKASHA upsert writes the state with no condition. The SQL CHECK lists values only. The Vault journal replays full book images with no order check. Only the engine keeps the order.

title: Spent handoff budget needs a second adapter call to retire
text: The engine sets retire_required and keeps handoff_only. The adapter then sends settle failed. If that call fails, the adapter retires locally and the Host keeps handoff_only. No Host timer retires the instance.

title: SQL permits contradictory instance field combinations
text: settled_outcome failed or aborted with a non-retired state is legal. handoff with a non-retired state is legal. warned false with wrapping or later is legal. handoff_requests above 0 outside handoff_only is legal. The writers keep them consistent today.

title: settled_outcome has no Rust type in the model
text: The model stores Option<String>. AKASHA reads raw text. The SQL CHECK stops an unknown value in PostgreSQL. The Vault journal deserializes the same Option<String>, so it accepts any text.

title: Liveness predicate exists in three copies
text: InstanceRecord::inactive is the engine copy. The Orihon PostgreSQL path restates it in SQL text and adds disposed_at. The Orihon Vault path calls inactive() and adds disposed_ms. A change to one copy does not change the others.

title: swarms.disposed_at has no guard
text: The swarms table has no trigger. An UPDATE can clear disposed_at after the entries are deleted, or set it with no dispositions row. The value is held twice, in swarms and dispositions.

title: Adapter replay is weaker than the live path
text: Replay changes an unknown bound state to working; the live path throws. Replay accepts a state line in any order. state and retired hold the same fact twice. markRetired may not run when the engine refuses an open (unverified).

title: Adapter reservation and slot flags permit contradictions
text: consumed and released are independent flags. linkSlot sets started with no settled check, so a settled slot can become started. The writers keep them consistent today.

title: Predecessor link has no foreign key
text: predecessor_instance_id has no REFERENCES clause. The engine sets it only from a found instance.

title: A failed connection stays failed until a page reload
text: connectRooms runs one time, at page load. No writer moves connection out of failed. The Host recovery listener does not call connectRooms. The repair banner shows the old reason until the operator reloads the page.

title: A pending chat round keeps the old failure reason
text: readSnapshot copies reason from the failed round into pending. chatBlockReason then shows the old reason. schedulePoll stays off until a live snapshot clears reason.

title: A failed repair round keeps the old matrix
text: Two failure writers copy matrix from the previous round into failed. renderRepair then shows the old component rows next to the failure.

title: The six view fields have no single writer
text: More than eight functions and event handlers write mode, activeId, activeView, houseReturn, selectedMessageKey, and drawerView. render writes mode, and renderInspector clears selectedMessageKey.

title: The retry clock holds a null timer with attempt above 0
text: queryHealthHost clears the timer and keeps attempt while the round is in flight. The live or failed writer sets the timer again when the request ends.

title: A throw from requestRender locks the room round
text: queryRoomStateHost sets roomInFlight and calls requestRender outside the try block. If that call throws, roomInFlight stays true, and the room round never runs again.

title: houseReturn stays set after the House view closes
text: openConversation does not clear houseReturn. Its only reader, leaveHouse, runs only when activeId is house. The stale value has no effect today.

title: Two repair starts can run at the same time
text: The proxy keeps no record of a running repair. The GUI guard covers one window only. Two windows, or a status and a start, start two repair child processes. The guard in the repair executable is unverified.

title: A repair child process has no time limit
text: The non-elevated path waits on output() with no limit. The GUI repair round stays pending until the child returns. The elevated path is unverified.

title: The views upsert accepts a lower revision
text: save_views sets revision to the incoming value with no comparison. The CHECK permits any revision of 1 or more. A writer without the owner lock, or a restore, can move the revision back. No such writer is known today.

title: The claim does not cap attempts
text: claim_next adds 1 to attempts on each claim. Only mark_publish_failure applies the cap. A publisher that stops after each claim lets attempts grow past 10, and the row never becomes a dead letter.

title: Two copies decide publish exhaustion
text: mark_publish_failure and the delivery loop both compare attempts with MAX_PUBLISH_ATTEMPTS. A change to one comparison does not change the other.

title: A completion after lease expiry is accepted
text: The completion updates check state and lease owner. They do not compare lease_expires_at with NOW(). A late completion succeeds when no publisher reclaimed the row. After a reclaim, the late completion fails, and JetStream drops the repeat.

title: The trigger upsert rewrites an outbox row in any state
text: ON CONFLICT sets room, integrity_sha256, and payload with no state condition. A conflict needs a second insert of the same memory id. The memory FK is ON DELETE RESTRICT, so no path to this state is known.

title: A telemetry row can pass the latch after shutdown starts
text: enqueue reads the latch, then counts the row, then sends it. Shutdown can close the latch between these steps, and the drain can exit before the send. If the count runs after the final read, the shutdown report undercounts.

title: The harness state lock stays held during a stop
text: stop_owned waits up to 15 seconds under the state lock. shutdown holds the lock across every harness. list waits for the lock with no limit, so a status request waits for each stop.

title: The type permits one harness in children and failures
text: Two maps hold one harness state. The type permits the same harness id in both maps. The writers keep the two maps exclusive today.

title: The pending attachment status has no writer
text: The status type declares pending. A search of session.ts for the pending literal finds the type and one message text only. No code path writes pending.

title: A heartbeat can mark a failed attachment connected
text: heartbeat awaits the Host and then sets connected to true with no status check. A poll that gets instance_stale in that window sets failed first. The attachment is then failed and connected.

title: heldBinding and the fence can name different holders
text: index.ts sets heldBinding before the first-wins fence adoption. If another session holds the fence, adoption does nothing. The chat doorman then idles, and the knock doorman starts with no fence check.

label: Chat log sequence and draft generation

title: A missing draft file stops the Host start
text: read_checkpoint returns generation 0 for a missing chat-drafts.json. When chat.json holds a higher draft_generation, open fails. The Host constructor returns that error. The drafts are transient.
